text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alert: p99 latency spike detected on eu-inference-prod. Metric: text.generate.p99=1.82s (baseline 0.34s). streaming.tail_stalls ↑. Alert rule: realtime-slo-eu. Triggered at 3239995555.
sre_anya: ACK — I’ll take lead. Paging @eng_oncall_jamie and @ml_infra_omar to triage.
eng_oncall_jamie: Oncall Jamie here, joining. Pulling dashboards (live p95/p99, queues, kvcache). Any known deploys around 09:40-10:00 UTC?
ml_infra_omar: I saw a canary rollout of kernel-selector v2.1 at ~09:46 in eu earlier. kv-cache hit rate dropped ~18% on older instances. Could be kernel selection + cache eviction thrash.
eng_oncall_jamie: Quick checks (past 5m):
```
avg(last_5m):text.generate.p95{env:prod,region:eu}=0.52s
max(last_5m):text.generate.p99{env:prod,region:eu}=1.82s
streaming.tail_stalls{env:prod,region:eu}=73
kvcache.hit_rate{env:prod,region:eu}=0.62 (baseline ~0.80)
queue.depth{pool:eu-gpu-a}=420 (typical ~40)
```
support_maya: Support has 3 P1s reporting slow chat replies >5s, one enterprise customer flagged "intermittent stalls" starting ~10:02 UTC. No large spike in errors.
sre_anya: Customer impact = partial (some chat flows slowed). If persistent >30m escalate to full incident writeup. For now we do live mitigation.
eng_oncall_jamie: Mitigation plan (fast):
- rollback kernel-selector canary in eu -> revert to v2.0
- enable fallback routing to small-llm-quant for non-critical traffic
- scale out streaming workers and increase kvcache TTLs
I’ll do the rollback first.
ml_infra_omar: Rolling rollback now -> kernel_selector.canary=false for eu. Also bumping kvcache TTL policy to reduce evictions.
eng_oncall_jamie: Applied rollback and TTL bump. Commands used:
```
/infra/flags set kernel_selector.canary false --env=eu --sync
/kvcache update-policy --env=eu --ttl 30s
```
Watching metrics.
sre_anya: Monitoring p99 trend.
eng_oncall_jamie: 3m post-rollback: p99=1.05s, p95=0.48s, queue.depth=90, streaming.tail_stalls=12 -> clear improvement.
support_maya: No new P1s in last 6m. Customers reporting reduced slowness.
product_lina: Thanks — please keep updates here. Follow-ups: RCA on kernel-selector gating, kvcache eviction tuning, and canary rollout checks. I’ll open a ticket and assign owners.
ml_infra_omar: Will start bisect of kernel-selector changes and collect per-instance profiles.
sre_anya: We’ll monitor for 30m and then decide to close page. If stable, create incident writeup with timeline and action items. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
eng_oncall_jamie: Pinned quick commands and query snippets in channel. Handoff to SRE for post-incident watch.
inc-bot: Incident status updated — acknowledged by sre_anya, mitigation in progress, impact: partial degradation, P1s reduced. Link: https://incidents.redwood/3239995555
